defects.workstream: P0: Stage 3 Schema Contract Foreign Key Target Concordance
defects.summary: Corrected constituency_demographics.constituency_id FK reference from public.constituencies(id) to public.constituencies(internal_id) in schema contract specification to match Migration 066 committed DDL
defects.directiveRequirement: Correct contract to match committed DDL exactly (public.constituency_demographics.constituency_id -> public.constituencies(internal_id)). Add automated assertion reading authoritative schema definition and verifying referenced table, column, local column, type, nullability. Fail if contract claims constituencies.id. Audit Stage 3 crosswalk contract to distinguish statutory composite identity, canonical external identifier, reproducible namespace UUID, and target-state surrogate key.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated reports/w021_5_schema_contract_specification.json under stage3_constituency_demographics to reference public.constituencies(internal_id). Added missingPrerequisite note in scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs clarifying target-state UUID resolution requirement. Added automated assertions in tests/database-criteria-identity-reconciliation.test.mjs (CRIT-E01-02 tests 9 and 10) verifying DDL concordance, failing on constituencies(id), and proving 4-identity crosswalk builder separation.

Expand reconciler and tests to cover matching aliases, duplicate incoming keys, conflicting organizations, national vs state scope, and overlapping validity periods.

Updated scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs verifiedConflictKeys and conflictTargets to null. Updated scripts/lib/stage1IdempotentReconciler.mjs computeNaturalKey to include valid_from, added duplicate incoming key detection (DUPLICATE_INCOMING_KEY) and source temporal overlap detection (INTERNAL_SOURCE_TEMPORAL_COLLISION). Expanded tests/stage1-idempotent-reconciler.test.mjs with tests 11 through 17.
